[[Guard Raabo]] is a [[Canthan Guard]] who will spawn in [[Wajjun Bazaar]] with his companion [[Guard Laonan]]. Upon approach a small dialogue will start between the two, in which he serves as a moralizing counter to Guard Laonan's mercenary attitude. Guard Raabo is one of several NPCs in the Bazaar who will spawn randomly. He does not appear to have any special purpose and is not linked to any quest.

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Wajjun Bazaar}}

==Dialogue==
When addressed, Guard Raabo uses the same set of dialogue as ordinary Canthan Guards.

==Quotes==
:'''Guard Laonan:''' ''"When do we get paid again?"''
:'''Guard Raabo:''' ''"Is that the only reason you joined? For the money?"''
:'''Guard Laonan:''' ''"Hey, the Emperor raised the pay so much that this is the best paying job in the city now. Why else would I be here?"''
:'''Guard Raabo:''' ''"To protect your fellow citizens, to stop the rampant thieving, to ensure the continued survival of our way of life?"''
:'''Guard Laonan:''' ''"Are you kidding? I'm getting out of this deathtrap as soon as possible."''
:'''Guard Raabo:''' ''"But what about the commitment you made when you joined the guard?"''
:'''Guard Laonan:''' ''"Relax. I'm going to finish my term, but after that I'm using whatever I make to get out of here."''
:'''Guard Raabo:''' ''"But what about all the people you swore to protect?"''
:'''Guard Laonan:''' ''"Let one of them take my job, they can have it. They can deal with fighting off the bandits, and having street urchins beg them for food, and guard against the plague monsters at the same time."''
:'''Guard Raabo:''' ''"Then why did you sign up for the guard if you don't like it?"''
:'''Guard Laonan:''' ''"I already told you, I need the money to get out of here. What are you doing with your extra pay?"''
:'''Guard Raabo:''' ''"I'm donating it to the various people who need help in these times of need. They need it more than I do, even if the Emperor was kind enough to give us all substantial raises in this time of crisis."''
:'''Guard Laonan:''' ''"Fine, you can donate some of that to my 'get me off this dirty, dying rock' fund."''
:'''Guard Raabo:''' ''"Speaking of disgusting, that describes your attitude perfectly."''
:'''Guard Laonan:''' ''"Then don't talk to me anymore and you won't have to be bothered with it."''
:'''Guard Raabo:''' ''"Fine...just don't ask me when we get paid again."''
